name: eBay Watch
description: Search eBay listings through a self-hosted flaresolverr instance and return structured deal candidates.

flaresolverrEndpoint.label: Flaresolverr Endpoint
flaresolverrEndpoint.help: Base URL of the flaresolverr instance (e.g. http://flaresolverr:8191). Must target a private/internal network.

defaultMaxResults.label: Default Max Results
defaultMaxResults.help: Default number of listings to return per search.
